At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

One workflow we would pilot with customer operations teams:

Customer operations
  Delegated: Handle order enquiries, returns and eligible refunds from the first message through to reconciliation.
  Stays with you: Disputed eligibility and amounts above the delegated limit go to a named reviewer.
  Exception: A return arrives after the stated window.

The page shows how that exception is handled and which records prove the case is complete.
